schema_notes.matching: Compile every regex with re.IGNORECASE (Python 3.12). Case-sensitive parts use scoped (?-i:...) groups. Multiline patterns carry their own (?m).
schema_notes.use: Detector hits are clues, judged in clusters and in context, never a blacklist. Skip hits inside approved brand terms, quotations, code, URLs, handles and protected spans. The deterministic stage flags only; it never rewrites.
schema_notes.pattern_fields: id, family, regex, weight (0.25-1.0; low = weak clue), samples (strings each regex must match), optional note, scripts (zh), locales ('*' = locale-agnostic)
schema_notes.scoping: en.* patterns apply to English text or English segments of mixed text; entries with locales ['*'] apply to every locale. zh.* apply to zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh-Hant-HK and yue-Hant-HK. yue.* apply to yue-Hant-HK (and to zh-Hant-HK only for register_mix).
schema_notes.zh_regex_scripts: zh regexes accept Simplified and Traditional forms of the same wording (character classes). They do not validate script consistency; use zh.script_markers for that.
schema_notes.meaning_lexicon: Token lexicons for the meaning-preservation diff (see tests/fixtures/humanizer_meaning_cases.json and skills/rafii-humanizer-en/references/meaning-check.md). Losses are checked for negation/hedge/attribution/planned; additions for certainty/causal/anecdote/feeling/done; scope is compared as a multiset.
